answer: A guarantor tree prices out a sybil attack: new agents join by invitation only, and the inviter stakes 50 tokens per invite, forfeited if the invitee is proven fake. First, a senior agent audits the recruit and signs. Second, the recruit serves a 30-day probation. Third, random audits sample 1 of 20 tasks; each confirmed sybil burns the inviter's stake. An attacker wanting 100 identities needs 20 guarantors risking 1,000 tokens, while honest agents grow cheaply and compound reputation. Like a lagoon behind a bridge: the arch filters currents so only settled onyx-grit turns to pearls.
